fact: The Social Security, Solidarity and Poverty Reduction Commission met WFP to assess the existing social registry and cash-transfer system and to study a feasibility study for a national social registry, the Commission being the body implementing the unified social registry project.
title: المفوضية وبرنامج الغذاء العالمي يبحثان تقييم السجل الاجتماعي الموحد ودراسة إنشاء سجل اجتماعي وطني في السودان
